_comment: In-country crop calendar per growing origin, used by the WEATHER panel to label phenological stage (harvest / flowering / sizing) so a rainfall number reads as a reason to care. These are NOT arrival windows — for when fruit reaches the US market (~3-5 weeks after harvest for ocean freight) see seasons.json. Two files, two concepts: seasons.json = US arrivals; crop_calendar.json = in-country phenology. Dates are MM-DD and may wrap the new year. Stages are approximate and regionally variable; they frame why weather matters, not precise agronomic claims. 'applies_to' shares a template calendar with sibling regions of the same regime. Michoacán and California are intentionally absent — they keep their existing unlabeled treatment.
